body: Quick pass (SKULL): stacked on #990 (merge order #990 then #1058). Clean against main; trial-merged against every other open SKULL PR: one textual overlap with #970 in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs` (both add a separate test at the same spot - keep both). #970 is a fix and merges first; this PR takes a /resolve-conflicts merge of main then. No goldens/PNGs; no unwrap/expect/panic outside tests. Marking ready.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ef57929b717faf27592affa89dcbf2406503e161 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The workholding limit wrongly refuses live-tool cross drilling. This PR also carries #990's open G96 finding.

I reviewed only the top commit `ef57929b`. Its parent is exactly #990's head `ed514853` (checked). Earlier `pr-reviewer` comments on this PR came from the contributor's own agents. This review is separate from them.

### What looks good
- **G96.** The clamp is min(machine, tool, workholding): `setup_workholding::css_of` folds the chuck rating into `MaxSpindleSpeed`, and the posts take the lower of that and the machine's. No post script changed.
- **G97.** A G97 turning op over the limit is refused by name at the program gate, never capped silently. Threading and the axial lathe drill are judged as well.
- **Validation.** 0, negative, NaN, inf and anything over 100000 are refused at command creation (`setup_workholding::invalid`). The project loader refuses the same values as a corrupt file. A no-op is refused.
- **Undo and MCP.** `SetSetupWorkholdingRpm` undoes exactly, and the MCP tool `set_workholding_max_rpm` runs the same command through History.
- **Schema and file format.** The field lives on `SetupDef` in `schema.rs`. The key is additive and skipped when unset. A datum transfer keeps the rating.
- **`None` posts as before.** No golden or snapshot changed.

### Local results (merged with main `23c62044`, clean merge)
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| app: lathe_workholding_rpm, mcp_workholding, project_roundtrip, setups, mcp_setup, mcp | 5 / 1 / 71 / 12 / 6 / 13 passed |
| app (#990's set again): lathe_post_css, golden_cl, solid_law_goldens, operations, lathe_post, lathe_post_tormach, lathe_post_refusals, cutting_data, lathe_spindle_law, c_axis_live, drilling_cross | all pass |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`, structural twin included) | 533 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
1. **The chuck limit is applied to the live-tool spindle** (`crates/app/src/setup_workholding.rs`, `program_problems`, the `spindle_law::turns` filter).
   - `turns` means "works about the spindle axis", so it includes the mill-turn's and the lathe's *cross* drill. Those holes are drilled by a live tool while the work is indexed in C, not spun.
   - Scratch test on the `drilling_cross` fixture: a mill-turn, Setup1, cross drill CD1 with DR-0400 at 10000 rpm, and a 100 rpm chuck limit. The gate reports:
     ```
     CD1: turns the work at 10000 rpm (G97), over setup 'Setup1''s workholding maximum of 100 rpm - ...
     ```
   - That is a false refusal, and its text is false: the chuck is not turning at 10000 rpm. A realistic case is a 2500 rpm chuck with a 3000 rpm live drill.
   - Fix: judge only the ops whose rpm drives the work spindle. Skip `Drill { cross }` with non-empty holes, and any op whose path carries C/rotary moves (posted as `LiveTool`).
   - Pin it with a cross-drill-under-a-chuck-limit test.
2. **#990's G96-to-live-section gap** (see the review on #990) also reaches this branch. It is fixed there.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The limit is not checked against the machine's spindle minimum (noted in the PR body).
- The `camcraft-mcp` skill table is left for a process PR (noted in the PR body).
- Merge order: #990 first, then this PR takes `git merge origin/main` and is re-gated. Both are `feat` and merge at the cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
